name: Dziban
description: A naked-eye star 22.8 parsecs away, 2.3 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 162003: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.949 +/- 0.026 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 2.329 +/- 0.067

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 162003: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.311 +/- 0.016

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 162003: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6014 +/- 90

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 162003: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 43.79 +/- 0.45 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 23 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 2.3 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.949 milliarcseconds, which gives 2.329 solar radii and 6,014 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 162003: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
